package.name: camera_tilt_bridge
package.description: Bridges /camera_tilt to /bus_servo for the STS3215 camera-tilt servo on the Yahboom expansion board's bus port (patched STM32 firmware -> little-endian STS). Publishes camera_tilt_joint_state for robot_state_publisher (open-loop, from commanded position). Lets joystick button Y + herbie tilt-tracking drive the tilt unchanged.
